guide_line: Use Boyle, Charles, Avogadro, and the combined gas law.
steps: Boyle: P1 V1 = P2 V2 at constant temperature.
Charles and Gay-Lussac need kelvin. K = °C + 273.
Avogadro: V1 / n1 = V2 / n2 at the same T and P.
Combined: P1 V1 / T1 = P2 V2 / T2.
